reels.caption:
Stopped by Zome Depot 😎
.
Built from my very own 20ft / 6m zome build plans 🫡 another one in the books. Busted this kit out over a couple of weeks in a covered space on the big island while I worked on the weirder geodesic pyramid project. The deck and kit went together in 12 working hours with 2 helpers - yes, that includes the roofing and windows installed.
.
Want to build your own? Tell me what you would do with it in the comments below and I will send you my latest zome builders method.
.
Want me to build one for you? Reach out. I travel all over the world to make people's dreams come true.
.
Special thanks to @sistersedona who built so much of this kit (her first time) with incredible attention to detail. Also to @sticky_hick and @hey_wheres_tumbl3 for saving my butt on assembly day.
.
What do you think? Does the cheap home depot roofing work?? Haha
.

reels.caption:
The desert looks empty.

It isn't.

An entire hotel exists below the dunes, hidden from the horizon and carved into the landscape.

From above: almost nothing.
Inside: descending terraces, warm rooms and water beneath an open desert sky.

The architecture does not compete with the landscape. It disappears into it.

One impossible concept. Directed like reality.

Would you stay here: YES or TOO DEEP?

Concept hospitality film.
